title: Juicy Turkish Cherry Pilaf
description: A cultured and cozy Turkish dish featuring cherry and a low-calorie pasta water emulsion, this pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Bring the cherry juice to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat
Add the orzo pasta to the saucepan and cook according to package instructions
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute
Once the pasta is cooked, drain it and add it to the skillet with the onion and garlic
Stir in the dried cherries, salt, and black pepper
Combine the cooked pasta mixture with the cherry juice and stir to combine
Reduce heat to low and simmer the pilaf for 5 minutes
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot
